landing.about.title: I'll be your guide on your journey to mastering the Spanish language and culture
landing.about.desc1: I am thrilled to share my passion for the Spanish language and culture with you.
landing.about.desc2: Whether you're just starting out or aiming for fluency, let's transform your Spanish goals into reality. Book a lesson, and let's embark on this incredible journey together!

landing.faq.title: Common Questions
landing.faq.a1: I welcome learners of all language levels, from complete beginners to advanced speakers. My experience allows me to tailor lessons to meet the needs of each individual.
landing.faq.a2: You have the flexibility to choose your preferred time by checking my calendar. Optionally, you can opt for a fixed schedule setting a lesson every week at the same time and day.
landing.faq.q3: How will the first lesson be?
landing.faq.a3: The first lesson is 30 minutes long. We will identify your needs, assess your level, and develop a personalized learning plan.

landing.studentPortal.title: Your All-in-One Space to Learn & Grow
landing.studentPortal.subtitle: Every student gets instant access to a dedicated learning dashboard. Manage your classes, review Marta's personalized feedback, and track your Spanish fluency journey in real-time.
landing.studentPortal.f1.title: 1-Click Video Classroom
landing.studentPortal.f1.desc: Jump right into your lesson via Google Meet or virtual room without searching for links in old emails.
landing.studentPortal.f2.title: Custom Vocabulary & Notes
landing.studentPortal.f2.desc: Access tailored vocabulary lists, error corrections, and learning materials carefully curated by Marta after every lesson.
landing.studentPortal.f3.title: Seamless Rescheduling & Sync
landing.studentPortal.f3.desc: Need to adjust a session? Reschedule effortlessly with real-time calendar availability and sync to Google, Apple, or Outlook.
landing.studentPortal.f4.title: Learning Stats & Milestones
landing.studentPortal.f4.desc: Watch your progress unfold with stats on completed lessons, practice hours, and conversation milestones.
